% Canonical definitions, inherited boundaries, products, support and lifecycle.
\newcommand{\NormOwnership}{\Unit{Ownership and inherited producer boundaries}{core:ownership}{%
FRUIT's boundary starts at the exact iteration input and state, with immutable
original measured-parent ancestry. It includes model construction/selection/
acceptance/application, removal, residual processing, exact bypass, rejoin,
successor state, completion and terminal selection. It ends at immutable
iteration or selected-terminal products. The target, measured signal, feedback
model, path contributions and result remain different scientific objects.

ALIGN/AST retain coordinate/event meaning; RTC/CAL retain conditioning and
calibration; PTC retains cleaning, operator families and application state;
MAP/JINC retain estimands, normalization, grouping, support and numerical
admission; NOI retains ensemble/uncertainty authority. Other producers retain
their exact product and transformation authority. FRUIT owns its internal
selection, update, transition, convergence/stopping, local completeness,
terminal selection and publication. It may bind an upstream operation's
placement and generation; it shall not redefine that producer's estimator.

\textbf{PTC ownership and application crosswalk.} The exact admitted
PTC\_APPLICATION\_REFERENCE.tex (SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5) is preserved verbatim.
PTC owns its estimator and exact fixed-state application map. FRUIT owns only
the response role assigned to a declared use of that upstream operation inside
a FRUIT method. The following specialization substitutes the admitted equations;
it changes no estimator, family, rank, support or upstream admission.

PTC-local $g,t$ mean detector group/time sample. Its local centered row $x$,
output row $z$ and modal application coordinate $\widehat m^{\rm app}$ are
PTC objects, distinct from KID readout, FRUIT result $z_k$ and feedback model
$\ma$. The loading matrix, metric and normal matrix define the PTC map;
the modal coordinate is evaluated from its operand. Ordinary fixed-subspace
projection, frozen numerical-component subtraction and relearning the defining
state remain separate procedures. The exact map and domain below determine
the FRUIT response classification; an internal application coefficient is
not an operator-defining coefficient.

Every required input and time-local normal matrix must be finite, with numerical
rank equal to the required rank under frozen tolerance. Deficiency makes that
group-time application/output unavailable with cause. A generalized inverse
permits no partial-rank subtraction, rank reduction, interpolation or borrowed
group. Exact output support controls publication. No mode count, metric,
projection orientation/family or learned state is selected here. Total removed
signal is input minus output, not just the fitted modal contribution.
Fixed-state linear null, re-estimated-centering invariance/unidentifiability
and affine reference loss remain distinct.

Each parent route supplies exact quantity, unit, frame, response, beam/template,
calibration, support/validity, lifecycle and provenance. If the ordinary
PTC-to-MAP route is selected, retain its calibrated-$x$-derived nonpolarimetric
total-intensity-equivalent, top-of-atmosphere point-source-equivalent mJy/beam,
fixed nominal beam/template and spectral/calibration lineage. This implies
neither Stokes I, true sky, a generic FRUIT target nor a universal unit.
A STOKES label supplies no authority. Processed occurrence identity requires
exact PTC output/modal-application-coordinate/QC and compatible coordinates, not row/time labels.
MAP permission does not imply JINC operator-family permission.

JINC remains a signed normalized observation-map estimator; its base authority
supplies no MAP coadd, response, variance, formal-weight, covariance, empirical-
noise or significance product. Conditional FRUIT obligations manufacture none.
Formal weight is not covariance/significance. Frozen descriptions do not fill
absent numerical parameters, support/adequacy or response authority.
}}
\newcommand{\NormSupport}{\Unit{Path support, occurrence classes and information origin}{core:support}{%
All eight roles are required and independently addressable; no method may waive
them. Bind exact scientific queries and path/operation/application identities,
with materialized or exactly reconstructible values or permitted typed status.
\begin{enumerate}
\item \textbf{Measured-parent support}: original measured occurrences, producer availability, domain and causes.
\item \textbf{Model-definition support}: separate candidate/accepted/applied spaces and definition supports, parent/prior origin, transformations and any exact equality.
\item \textbf{Projection/removal support}: where the projected applied operand and compatible subtraction exist, including mapping/boundary/missing-data behavior.
\item \textbf{Residual-processing support}: every operation's input/output support, retained membership and causes.
\item \textbf{Model-rejoin support}: where the exact rejoin contribution exists, independently of removal support.
\item \textbf{Final output support}: the declared output domain and permitted composition.
\item \textbf{Learning influence}: transitive dependence of learned/selected state on inputs, not local membership or acquired exposure.
\item \textbf{Response-query support}: exact role, source basis/domain, conditioning, output support and limitations.
\end{enumerate}
A common mask, array shape or coordinate label does not establish identity.
Acceptance does not imply application on identical support. Each operand pair
still requires full quantity/reference/gauge/null-space compatibility.

\texttt{residual\_and\_model\_supported} means both contributions exist and may
be combined under the exact method. \texttt{residual\_only} and
\texttt{model\_only} require explicit permission for the narrower path
composition; absence is not a numerical zero. \texttt{unavailable} retains
cause and affected scope when the requested output lacks a permitted
composition or required input. A method may prohibit any class. Merely having
a model at an unmeasured location does not authorize model-only output.

Undefined unequal-support behavior is unavailable. No implicit zero fill,
extrapolation, imputation, renormalization, nearest substitution, model completion,
reference offset or gauge alignment is permitted. Any mapping/restriction into
a common result space shall be exactly bound by the method.

An upstream unavailable absolute/additive mode remains observationally
unavailable after rejoin. Its contribution is \texttt{model\_or\_prior\_supported},
not \texttt{observationally\_measured}, \texttt{recovered\_from\_data},
\texttt{acquired\_exposure} or \texttt{unit\_response\_truth}. This is a
mode-origin state, not a fifth occurrence class; even a residual-and-model
occurrence may contain it. Record reference/gauge/null-space identity and
response/uncertainty consequences. Choosing a gauge creates no observation or
measured zero uncertainty. Iteration, projection and rejoin create no exposure
or independent measurement. Original producer exposure, path contribution and
transitive learning influence remain distinct; no absent exposure product is
invented. Shared parents/models/calibration/response/reference preserve dependence.
}}
\newcommand{\NormProducts}{\Unit{Exact product identities and scientific handoff}{core:products}{%
Every instance binds exact role, method, immutable parents, quantity/domain/units,
support/origin, state/application/iteration/branch/lineage/product generation,
availability, outcome/cause and provenance. The core-declared product roles are:
\begin{description}
\item[SCI-FRUIT/ITERATION-RESULT] Child numerical payload $z_k$. Scientific consumption requires the exact ITERATION-BUNDLE or its immutable exact reference; a bare array is not a complete handoff.
\item[SCI-FRUIT/ITERATION-BUNDLE] All universal and method-required roles and exact bindings.
\item[SCI-FRUIT/SUCCESSOR-STATE] Produced $S_{k+1}$ and causal lineage; sufficiency remains distinct.
\item[SCI-FRUIT/CONTINUATION-STATE] Exact future-consequential state queries, reconstruction and sufficiency status.
\item[SCI-FRUIT/PATH-SUPPORT] Eight separately bound support/influence roles.
\item[SCI-FRUIT/INFORMATION-ORIGIN] Occurrence/path origin and separate mode-origin state.
\item[SCI-FRUIT/TERMINAL-SELECTION] Separate immutable selector over completed iterations.
\item[SCI-FRUIT/TERMINAL-PRODUCT] Selector plus immutable selected completed bundle or exact reference.
\item[SCI-FRUIT/MODEL-PATH-TRANSFER] $D_k$ under complete fixed linearity; operator domain/codomain, units and conditioning are exact.
\item[SCI-FRUIT/MODEL-INDUCED-OUTPUT-SHIFT] $\Delta z_k^{\mathrm{model}}=D_k\delta m_k^{\ap}$; deterministic difference is not covariance or bias.
\item[SCI-FRUIT/MODEL-INDUCED-BIAS] $b_{z,k}^{\mathrm{model}}$ only with exact estimand/reference/error-law/conditioning authority; may be unavailable while transfer/shift exist.
\item[SCI-FRUIT/MODEL-MISMATCH] Exact model/reference discrepancy and domain; separate from bias, output shift and covariance.
\end{description}
The core-declared response-role vocabulary is
\texttt{SCI-FRUIT/RESPONSE/RF-01}, \texttt{SCI-FRUIT/RESPONSE/RF-02},
\texttt{SCI-FRUIT/RESPONSE/RF-03}, \texttt{SCI-FRUIT/RESPONSE/RF-04},
\texttt{SCI-FRUIT/RESPONSE/RF-05}, \texttt{SCI-FRUIT/RESPONSE/RF-06}, and
\texttt{SCI-FRUIT/RESPONSE/RF-07}. Each binds the corresponding exact query,
conditioning, domains, state/generation and status defined in the response
sections. This is a closed declaration of these seven roles, not an unexplained
placeholder or a claim that a numerical response exists.

These roles create no new generic numerical parent class. Scientific consumption
also retains the exact underlying MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, FLT-MATCHED, detector-time
or other method-defined producer quantity and its admission authority.
}}
\newcommand{\NormLifecycle}{\Unit{Immutable request state and producer-stage branching}{core:lifecycle}{%
\texttt{request\_state} is \texttt{not\_requested} or \texttt{requested}
for one immutable request generation. There is no transition from not-requested
to requested within it; a later request creates a new request generation.
For a requested generation the successful producer-stage order is
\[
\begin{gathered}
\texttt{requested}\to\texttt{effective}\to\texttt{application\_scope\_resolved}\to\texttt{applied}\\
\to\texttt{iteration\_realized}\to\texttt{complete\_iteration\_candidate}
\to\texttt{completion\_decided}\\
\to\texttt{completed\_iteration}\to\texttt{published}.
\end{gathered}
\]
\texttt{requested} binds the request; \texttt{effective} the effective action;
\texttt{application\_scope\_resolved} its exact resolved scope/state.
\texttt{applied} means the operation was invoked. \texttt{iteration\_realized}
means immutable numerical path values and execution-outcome records exist.
\texttt{complete\_iteration\_candidate} means every required role has an exact
value or a core-and-method-permitted status. \texttt{completion\_decided}
records the FRUIT-owned exact local decision. \texttt{completed\_iteration}
means that candidate satisfies the rule. \texttt{published} exposes the immutable
completed product under its role.

Separately type scientific availability as \texttt{available} or
\texttt{unavailable}, and producer outcome as \texttt{realized},
\texttt{failed} or \texttt{not\_produced}. Every branch/role outcome binds
stage actually reached, affected scope, cause and generation. These are not
mandatory steps in the successful path. Early stop shall not fabricate applied,
realized, completion or publication records. Preserve every stage actually
reached and every attempt. Unavailable optional companions may coexist with a
narrower complete product only when both core and exact method permit it.

\texttt{superseded} is an immutable replacement relation, not erasure or a
mandatory producer stage. Restart/retry/new-request identities preserve their
parents and cannot relabel a stopped attempt as success. Terminal selection
consumes completed iterations and creates a separate immutable selector record;
it does not mutate the selected bundle.

Downstream decisions are separate child records. Base iteration and terminal
completion do not depend on absent or failed downstream use. An exact explicitly
requested FRUIT product role may require a child; that dependency is local to
that declared requested role, never an implicit requirement of the base roles.
}}
\newcommand{\NormUncertaintyRoles}{\Unit{Closed uncertainty-role grammar and law-bound availability}{core:uncertainty-roles}{%
The closed FRUIT uncertainty-role grammar has prefix
\texttt{SCI-FRUIT/UNCERTAINTY/} followed by exactly one terminal token in this
closed table. Concatenating prefix and token is the exact product identity;
no undeclared \texttt{<role>} placeholder is admitted.
\begin{description}
\item[MEASURED-PARENT-COVARIANCE] Exact random-parent law and compatible covariance axes.
\item[CANDIDATE-MODEL] Candidate-model uncertainty, construction and any candidate prior; not accepted covariance.
\item[CANDIDATE-SELECTION] Selection dependence and its effect on the exact target.
\item[ACCEPTED-MODEL-COVARIANCE] Accepted axes/support/reference; not copied into applied space.
\item[ACCEPTANCE-TO-APPLICATION] Exact transformation uncertainty and dependence, including deterministic facts.
\item[APPLIED-MODEL-COVARIANCE] Applied axes and law used by conditional propagation.
\item[PARENT-APPLIED-CROSS-COVARIANCE] Both compatible orientations and dependence; no independence by omission.
\item[OPERATOR-STATE] Consequential operator/state variation; exact method required.
\item[SUPPORT-THRESHOLD-SELECTION] Exact support/threshold-selection law and domain.
\item[STOPPING-TERMINAL-SELECTION] Exact rule/population/selection-conditioned target authority.
\item[EXTERNAL-PRIOR] External prior law, origin and dependence, separately from model-stage products.
\item[EMPIRICAL-REPEATABILITY] Exact repeat population; no automatic analytic covariance or coverage.
\item[NOI-PRODUCT-REFERENCE] Immutable reference to the exact NOI-owned uncertainty product identity, generation and content digest. The external role/law/estimator binding is currently \texttt{unavailable\_external\_binding}; this FRUIT reference does not invent or replace the NOI-owned product.
\end{description}
Every role independently binds quantity/domain/axes, units (including covariance
product units), target law/random variables/fixed objects/resolution condition,
omitted variation, support/reference/gauge/null-space, availability/cause and
generation. One storage container is allowed only when all distinctions remain
lossless. Accepted covariance reaches applied covariance only through exact
transformations and dependence, including transformation uncertainty.

Model mismatch, model-path transfer, model-induced output shift and model-induced
bias have the distinct product identities above. They are not implicitly members
of this covariance/uncertainty family. A deterministic discrepancy or shift is
not covariance; a computable shift does not establish bias. No absent source,
mode or estimator becomes measured zero uncertainty.
}}

\newcommand{\NormState}{\Unit{Operation state, method identity and exact continuation}{core:state}{%
$S_0$ is the initial seed. The generic transition records roles without selecting
an update or recurrence:
\[
(S_k,\yin)\longrightarrow(m_k^{\ca},m_k^{\ac},\ma,\rho_k,z_k,S_{k+1}).
\]
Every method declares whether $\yin$ is original parent, previous result,
reconstruction from base parent/cumulative model or another exact product,
with every domain conversion. Returning to base and reprocessing a prior
result are different methods even with the same update. Immutable measured
base ancestry persists. Causal update, cumulative model, diagnostic difference,
accepted/applied model and iteration result are separate roles; no increment
meaning is inferred from $z_k$.

A method-rule change in parent route, grouping, recomputation, learning/model
construction, operator family, sign, order, bypass graph, support, recurrence,
stopping, terminal selector or failure behavior requires a new method identity.
Changed operator-defining coefficients, learned state or model values under
unchanged resolution rules require distinct realized state/application generations,
not a new method each. Internal application coordinates evaluated by the same
fixed map may change without relearning, re-resolution, a new method or a new
operator generation. Their operand/query/value provenance remains explicit.
Use grouping-neutral \texttt{application\_scope\_resolved} and distinct
\texttt{learned\_candidate}, \texttt{resolved\_model\_state},
\texttt{applied\_model\_state}, \texttt{realized\_iteration\_state}; not every
model is fitted. Requested, effective, resolved and realized remain distinct.

Factor each operation and consequential component into exactly one category
at its exact conditioning scope: \textbf{fixed numerical operator} (exact map,
state; linearity separate); \textbf{fixed structural state with recomputed operator-defining
coefficients} (structure, resolution rule, dependencies, realized map);
\textbf{externally supplied} (owner/parent/version, not implied independent);
\textbf{relearned} (rule, population, dependence, generation, failure);
\textbf{bypassed} (exact absent model-path operation, locations/counts on both
paths); \textbf{not\_applicable} (permitted absent role/reason);
\textbf{unavailable} (missing/incompatible fact/cause/domain/blocked claim).
Mixed stages are factored; each entry binds owner, parent/generation, inputs,
order, count, path and failure. Different conditioning scopes use separate records. Internal fixed-map coordinates
are evaluation values, not an eighth operation-state category; their changes
alone do not convert a fixed operator into a re-resolved one.

Every method shall bind its exact stochastic generator/algorithm, keys/counters/
state, populations and sampling controls where applicable; otherwise it shall
record a justified \texttt{not\_applicable}. No numerical values are selected here.

After completion of the iteration with absolute zero-based index $N$,
continuation begins at absolute index $N+1$ from $S_{N+1}$. $N$ is an index,
not a count. Exact continuation requires the same compatible future controls/
numerical profile and all state capable of changing future required results:
base parent; candidate/accepted/applied and cumulative models; learned/operator
state; supports/masks; update/selection/convergence history; counters/resources;
stochastic algorithm/generator/key/counter state where applicable; method/
parameter versions; branch/generations; reference/gauge/null-space state and
all upstream/model parents. No finite list excuses another consequential fact.
Exact state queries/reconstruction/failure contracts may be materialized,
compact or lineage-reconstructible. Representation alone does not change state.
Continuation must agree in scientific state/results with uninterrupted execution.

Restart creates a new lineage with explicit reused ancestry; initialization/
counters follow its method. Relearning under unchanged rules may be an exact
continuation successor. Branch records departure and parent state. Retry is a
new attempt with exact state/randomness/failure accounting, not a new observation
or implicit reset. Seed, continuation, restart, successor, branch, retry,
completion, terminal selection and publication retain separate identities.
}}
\newcommand{\NormTerminal}{\Unit{Completion, comparable terminal candidates and downstream decisions}{core:terminal}{%
Universal iteration-bundle roles are: immutable base parent; exact input;
method/lineage/branch/absolute iteration; target and separate candidate/accepted/
applied models/spaces/transformations/equality facts; projected removal,
residual, processed residual, rejoin and result; update/successor; all path
support/influence and information origin; response/uncertainty states; validity/
causes; continuation state; completion/failure and provenance. Removal/rejoin
bind full additive/reference/gauge/null-space compatibility and unavailable-mode
consequences. Path values are available or exactly reconstructible on claimed support.

No method may waive universal roles or hard dependencies. A numerical result
needs exact input/applied operand and all required compatible contributions;
continuation needs all causal state/profile compatibility; a numerical response/
uncertainty needs its exact premises/inputs/domains/conditioning; terminal
selection needs a separate immutable reference to a completed compliant bundle.
An absent role requires core-permitted \texttt{not\_applicable} plus the method's
narrower composition. Unknown is unavailable, never zero, identity, bypass or
omission. Unavailable companions permit only narrower claims allowed by both
core and method. Numerical draft completion is not claimed here.

Keep iteration completion, resource limit, convergence, policy stop, failure,
terminal selection and consumer fitness separate. Convergence binds proposition,
quantity/domain, metric/norm, scale/denominator, tolerance, direction,
persistence/consecutive rule, missing/non-finite behavior, generation and state.
No value is chosen. Limits/completion do not prove convergence; convergence
proves neither correctness, unit response, unbiasedness nor fitness.

A terminal selector consumes one or more completed iterations using one exact
predeclared rule with data access, ties and failure behavior. Candidates shall
share, or be mapped by exact selector-owned transformations into, common
quantity/role, unit/scale, frame/grid/domain, additive reference/gauge,
response meaning, support comparison domain, method/generation relation and
uncertainty/metric meaning. Shape or a common scalar diagnostic is insufficient.
Comparing methods/routes/groupings/gauges/generations/supports makes every
conversion/comparison rule part of selector method identity. Unavailable
comparisons, causes and exclusions remain, never a default last/latest,
lowest-residual or visually favorable choice.

Nine terminal fields remain required: selected completed identity; full candidate
population with every inclusion/exclusion and conversion; exact rule/generation
and ties/failure; convergence/stop/resource facts; selection causes; RF-05
response/status with any RF-07 composition; exact terminal uncertainty/conditioning/
omissions; continuation/terminality state; requested linked named-use decision identities
and exact statuses, or an explicit statement that no downstream use was requested.
All retain scope, generation, reference/gauge/null-space consequences and cause.
Missing a hard selection dependency blocks selection. The immutable selector
never mutates, relabels or replaces the selected bundle.

}}
\newcommand{\NormDownstream}{\Unit{Open-world named use and SCI-VAL accounting}{core:downstream}{%
Field 9 is open-world: retain only explicitly requested or linked downstream
records, not an exhaustive list of future uses. For SCI-VAL-governed use retain
separate exact request, applicability, eligibility and realization states plus
profile/source binding. Not-requested creates no eligibility proposition.
Missing profile/unresolved scope may yield a realized accounting record with
\texttt{applicability\_unknown} and \texttt{decision\_unavailable}; generic
\texttt{unavailable} is not a SCI-VAL realization value. Incomplete, failed or
not-produced decision artifacts are separate realization conditions. Exact
external SCI-VAL profile/source bindings remain unavailable when not supplied;
the owner-directed distinctions above do not invent them.

Pointing/OOF/source/catalogue/production admission remains separate child
work. Absent or failed downstream use does not erase base local completeness.
Only an exact explicitly requested FRUIT product role can require a specified
child; that narrower dependency does not alter base iteration/terminal roles.
Later child records reference immutable parents without mutation or a new FRUIT
iteration generation. SCI-VAL evaluates an exact approved use policy; it does
not run FRUIT, advance recurrence, select the model or choose the terminal.
}}
